citations.quote: 賬上的錢在子公司。按照國稅法，向海外母公司派息，要交10%稅，如果子公司轉100億元往香港公司，只有90億元到賬，增加10億元稅項支出，直接影響利潤。
恒大的應收已經撥備，公司現在的應收都是銀行票據，風險較低，公司會加大風險管理。
公司今年是上市以來首次派特別股息，現在公司的現金流很好，和以前不一樣。

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Reported cash overstates what an HK-listed firm with PRC subsidiaries can pay out: dividending cash up to the overseas parent incurs 10% withholding (100億 sent, 90億 received). Read a small dividend against heavy debt, scrutinize receivable quality and provisioning, beware high-leverage partners, and treat a first-ever special dividend with strong cash flow as a capital-return signal.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Balance-Sheet Quality: Distributable Cash, Repatriation Tax, Receivables, Leverage
